# GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}/members/{username}

Check if a user is a member of an organization. Returns 204 if member, 303 redirect to public_members check if doer is not a member/admin, 404 if not a member.

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-072`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| username | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **303** — Doer is not a member/admin - redirects to public_members endpoint
- **404** — User is not a member of the org (when doer is member/admin)

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | orgAssignment | middleware | Resolve org by name |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.GetContextUserByPathParam | utility | Resolve user by name; Handle user redirects |
| 3 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | org.IsMember | controller | Check if doer is org member; If member/admin: check target user membership; If not member: redirect to public_members |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| IsMember check: if doer is member/admin, directly checks target; otherwise redirects to public_members | authorization | userIsMember || ctx.Doer.IsAdmin |
| IsMember: if doer is the target user and not a member, return 404 (don't redirect) | authorization | ctx.Doer.ID == userToCheck.ID && !userIsMember |
| IsMember: non-member doer checking another user gets 303 redirect to public_members endpoint | authorization | Doer is not member, not admin, and not the target user |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| GetUserByName returns ErrUserNotExist | 404 | notFound | False |
| Target user not in org_user | 404 | notFound | False |

### Error Paths

- **Org not found** → orgAssignment → 404
- **User not found** → GetContextUserByPathParam → 404
- **Target user not a member (doer is member)** → IsMember → 404
- **Doer not a member/admin** → IsMember → 303
